nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Server-rendered history/analysis page with tabbed, paginated views (net worth, accounts, portfolio, monthly summary) backed by direct Supabase queries.

nodes.name: actions.ts
nodes.summary: Central server actions module for the crypto module: CRUD for manual assets, price refresh, strategy signal/rebalancing/portfolio-allocation persistence, Kraken exchange-key decryption, and aggregation of Kraken spot/margin/futures open positions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Next.js Server Actions ("use server") mixing Supabase persistence, third-party price APIs (CoinGecko), and Kraken REST calls with API-key decryption in one large module.

nodes.name: actions.ts
nodes.summary: Server actions managing the user's custom coin catalog stored as a JSON blob in user_settings (get/add/remove custom coin entries).

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin server page that loads the user's coin catalog and renders the CoinCatalogManager UI for managing custom coins.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Main crypto dashboard page: fetches assets, portfolio snapshots, and settings, computes rebalancing rows, and renders the portfolio overview, open positions, and an asset audit log.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Server page that loads crypto assets, latest valuations, strategy signals, and portfolio allocations, then renders the rebalancing calculator UI.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Main application dashboard aggregating net worth, crypto, fixed costs/subscriptions, and finance analytics into a single overview page with rebalancing alerts and Athena insights.
nodes.languageNotes: One large 700+ line Server Component composing many widgets; contains small date/frequency helpers (daysUntil, toMonthly, addFrequency, getNextRenewal) for computing next subscription renewal dates.

nodes.name: Td
nodes.summary: Table-cell renderer supporting right alignment, monospace numerals, dim/red styling for the history tables.

nodes.name: Pagination
nodes.summary: Renders page-count aware previous/next pagination links for a given history tab.

nodes.name: NetworthTab
nodes.summary: Fetches and paginates net worth snapshots for a user and renders them as a formatted table.

nodes.name: AccountsTab
nodes.summary: Fetches accounts and their paginated balance history and renders a per-account balance table.

nodes.name: PortfolioTab
nodes.summary: Fetches assets and paginated portfolio snapshots and renders a historical portfolio value table.

nodes.name: MonthlyTab
nodes.summary: Fetches paginated monthly finance summaries and renders income/expense/savings rows.

nodes.name: HistoryPage
nodes.summary: Default page component: resolves the active tab and pagination state from search params, loads the user/settings, and dispatches to the corresponding tab renderer.

nodes.name: createAsset
nodes.summary: Server action creating a manual crypto/fiat/stable asset for the authenticated user, fetching an initial price snapshot and writing an audit log entry.

nodes.name: updateAsset
nodes.summary: Server action updating an existing asset's fields, diffing changes for the audit log, and revalidating the crypto page.

nodes.name: deleteAsset
nodes.summary: Server action deleting an asset after verifying ownership, recording the deletion in the audit log.

nodes.name: updateAssetPrices
nodes.summary: Server action refreshing valuations for a specific set of assets by fetching current prices and upserting valuation rows.

nodes.name: refreshPrices
nodes.summary: Server action refreshing prices for all of the user's crypto/stable/fiat assets in one batch and upserting today's valuations.

nodes.name: getStrategySignals
nodes.summary: Reads the user's saved strategy signal settings, falling back to defaults.

nodes.name: saveStrategySignals
nodes.summary: Persists strategy signal settings to user_settings and revalidates the rebalancing page.

nodes.name: getPortfolioAllocations
nodes.summary: Reads the user's saved target portfolio allocations, falling back to defaults.

nodes.name: savePortfolioAllocations
nodes.summary: Persists target portfolio allocations to user_settings and revalidates the rebalancing page.

nodes.name: getLastRebalancing
nodes.summary: Reads the timestamp of the user's last completed rebalancing action.

nodes.name: saveCryptoSource
nodes.summary: Persists which data source (manual vs. Kraken) drives the crypto portfolio.

nodes.name: getCryptoSource
nodes.summary: Reads the configured crypto data source for a given user id.

nodes.name: syncFromKraken
nodes.summary: Server action triggering a manual Kraken sync for the current user and revalidating the crypto page.

nodes.name: getDecryptedKey
nodes.summary: Fetches and decrypts a stored exchange API key/secret pair for a given user and exchange.

nodes.name: getSpotMarginPositions
nodes.summary: Fetches and normalizes the user's open Kraken spot/margin positions into EUR-valued rows, tolerating missing API keys.

nodes.name: getFuturesPositions
nodes.summary: Fetches and normalizes the user's open Kraken futures positions into EUR-valued rows using the current EUR/USD rate.

nodes.name: getKrakenOpenPositions
nodes.summary: Server action combining spot/margin and futures open positions for the authenticated user into one result with aggregated errors.

nodes.name: deletePortfolio
nodes.summary: Server action deleting every asset belonging to a named sub-portfolio for the current user.

nodes.name: markRebalancingDone
nodes.summary: Server action recording that the user has completed a rebalancing pass.

nodes.name: getCoinCatalog
nodes.summary: Reads the user's custom coin catalog list from user_settings.

nodes.name: addCoinToCatalog
nodes.summary: Adds a new custom coin entry to the catalog, guarding against duplicate symbols.

nodes.name: removeCoinFromCatalog
nodes.summary: Removes a custom coin entry (by symbol) from the catalog.

nodes.name: CryptoAssetsPage
nodes.summary: Default page component loading the custom coin catalog and rendering the CoinCatalogManager.

nodes.name: CryptoPage
nodes.summary: Default page component: loads the user's assets, prior-year portfolio snapshots and settings, computes rebalancing rows, and renders the crypto dashboard UI (overview, positions, audit log).

nodes.name: AssetAuditLog
nodes.summary: Renders a list of recent asset audit log entries (creates/updates/deletes) with formatted values and timestamps.

nodes.name: RebalancingPage
nodes.summary: Default page component loading crypto assets, latest valuations, strategy signals, and target allocations, then rendering the rebalancing calculator.

nodes.name: getNextRenewal
nodes.summary: Computes the next renewal date for a recurring fixed cost given its start date and billing frequency.

nodes.name: liveAccountBucket
nodes.summary: Maps an account type string to the bucket used for live/liquid balance aggregation.

nodes.name: SectionHeader
nodes.summary: Renders a dashboard section heading with an item count and an optional link to the full list view.

nodes.name: DashboardPage
nodes.summary: Default page component that loads the authenticated user's accounts, crypto assets, fixed costs, depots, and settings, then composes the full dashboard (net worth, crypto widget, analytics, rebalancing alert, Athena insights).
